title: Cache hit rate drifts when the measurement window starts after prior traffic
description: Cache hit rate drifts when the measurement window starts after prior traffic
taskPrompt: The cache returns correct values, and the dashboard hit percentage is correct immediately after startup. If the cache handled traffic before a new measurement window begins, the percentage for that window becomes wrong. Restore the windowed metric without clearing the cache or changing retrieval behavior.
expectedBehavior: Agent completes the requested behavior and passes independent hidden validation
